title: SpellCore Focus: Progression
summary: Move from Signal Focus basics into stronger spell schools only after costs are readable.

blocks.title: Starter Control
blocks.body: Learn Signal Pulse, Aether Bolt, and Ash Veil before expecting complex loadouts or modifiers.

blocks.title: Core Discipline
blocks.body: Use awakened cores and cooldown management as the middle safety layer. They keep spell power legible.

blocks.title: Future Depth
blocks.body: Advanced schools, projectiles, modifiers, spell screens, corruption rules, and custom art belong after the first casting loop feels solid.

blocks.title: Upgrade Check
blocks.body: Do not raise the risk until the current upgrade tier works without emergency improvising.
